name: [FinOps][Advisory] Azure OpenAI prompt cache match rate regression

esqlQuery.esql: FROM metrics-azure_openai.metrics-* | WHERE azure.open_ai.context_tokens_cache_match_rate.avg IS NOT NULL | STATS cache_rate = AVG(azure.open_ai.context_tokens_cache_match_rate.avg), samples = COUNT(*) BY azure.resource.name | WHERE samples > 20 AND cache_rate < 30 | SORT cache_rate ASC
